name: Protopasta Rigid TPU @base
filament_notes:
Clear Rigid TPU, about 70D (replaced the earlier White Rigid TPU). Discontinued; kept for existing stock.
Product page: start printing at 240C, no bed heat needed; prep the bed with Magigoo to avoid a permanent bond; drying overnight recommended. This profile sets no values of its own and inherits Orca's Generic TPU values (240C nozzle, 35C bed, 3.2 mm3/s cap).
